inputs.doc: E-043e · Trains a FRESH 38.0M pentad codec on the r2 tensor (the 39 AMOC channels plus daily OISST SST as channel 40) with NO longitude holdout — the new PENTAD BASELINE, folding SST and the corrected holdout regime into one run (recipe f4r2-40M-nolonhold, holdout_lon '0,0') · params 37.976M · stage encoder · data family4_na025_pentad_r2 (C 40, T 3142) · arch 512x12, 4 heads, d_dec 256, d_z 32, patch 1 · steps x batch 200,000 x 512, cosine 3e-4 to zero · resume EMPTY — a fresh codec; f3_anchor41M's 39-row chan_emb cannot encode 40 channels, so there is nothing to seed from. CONTROLS: #386 (E-038a, the r1 39-channel pentad codec at this exact architecture) and cancelled #411 (E-042 SST arm, killed at step 107,000/200,000), whose 14 shared full-probe steps gave linear_r_deseas +0.0246 for SST at n=1. BUDGET, and it is a deliberate deviation from #386's verbatim block: max_minutes 1150 and job_timeout 1500 against #386's 850/1000, because run-386.jsonl records that #386's own 850-minute budget re-fit its cosine from 200,000 steps to 166,752 — a baseline whose step count is an accident of one box's speed is not a baseline, and ml/CLAUDE.md §1 asks the job to be sized against its own timeout. HYPOTHESIS: SST and all-longitude training both help, and this codec's head + raw-3x3 pair beats #386's. FALSIFIER: if its probe ladder does not exceed #386's, neither change buys anything at pentad cadence and the pentad baseline stays where it is. VERIFY IN THE FIRST MINUTES (§2): "NO lon holdout — all 481 cols train (--holdout-lon '0,0')", a train-pixel count ~4/3 of #386's, C 40 in the provenance channel list, and NO "re-fitting the cosine schedule" line. §3b: pentad cadence has NO measured pair anywhere in the archive, so one seed runs now and the replicate is bought before any number from it is quoted.
